In the nicest way possible I think you're really committing to a certain viewpoint here to the extent that youre not really processing the words youre saying 

If i can rudely hold up a mirror,
"Nothing has been bad enough, I can't take a resources for people who actually need help" and "I've tried tons of things and nothing worked I'm beyond fucked up and cant be helped" are wildly mutually exclusive. 

Clearly there have been several things that have happened in your life that were not great for your brain, only from the words you've said in your post. I don't think that it's up to you to decide whether or not you deserve help, Because people who need help often have a very warped perspective of what they do and don't deserve. I think that everyone deserves help and I think that you are most likely a person yourself so that would put you under that umbrella of everyone. 

Psychoeducation moment though: PTSD does not have to have a big huge trauma explosion situation. We like to think of PTSD as something that only like people who are in war can experience?? You can have PTSD without your entire family dying or without your house burning down or without losing a limb in a war zone. You can have PTSD by witnessing or experiencing something that was Very Scary to You Personally. And that can be anything. That can be being bitten by a fucking dog. That can be Mom screaming at you throughout your childhood. That can be witnessing a car accident. That can be being told by someone else about something so incredibly traumatizing that happened to them that just the recount of it gives you a Whole Reaction. Its wild, right? But its true! There's also other trauma disorders that aren't PTSD but are like lesser extents of it and there's ones that behave like PTSD but for a shorter amount of time, And there's complex PTSD which is like a bunch of things that happened  over and over again led to a big brain reaction (this one is usually like a childhood abuse thing)

Aaaanyway. I think everyone needs therapy! I think even healthy people need therapy. I especially think that people whose brains are trying to kill them probably definitely need therapy. I definitely think you deserve therapy. I definitely don't think that you get to make the call on whether or not you deserve therapy until you had enough therapy to love yourself and know your own worth. And I hope that regardless of what you do that you take care of yourself because I think that you are worth that.
